text: Yes, that's logical, and it's nearly what the card does now. Subaccount only: profit = everything that came back (settlement payouts + bid rebates) minus everything that went out (fills' costs + fees), or equivalently what the account is worth now minus net deposits (deposits minus withdrawals). Two catches: (1) bets still open have paid nothing back yet, so they must either be counted at what they cost or left out of both sides, otherwise profit looks lower the more bets are open (280 are open now); (2) withdrawals have to be subtracted from deposits. The card already does the second. The $72 mismatch suggests the card's open-bet cost ($240) disagrees with the ledger. I'll rebuild the all-time number straight from the subaccount's ledger (settlements + rebates - fills - fees, open bets shown separately) and check it against the wallet, so it can't drift from the bet list. Tracking as CH87b.
